title: 🚨 MOST CHRISTIANS WANT PEOPLE SAVED…
paragraphs:
🚨 MOST CHRISTIANS WANT PEOPLE SAVED…
But many have NO IDEA how to actually organize outreach.

So churches stay inside buildings.
Believers stay silent.
And entire cities remain unreached.

Meanwhile…
people are battling depression, addiction, hopelessness, and spiritual darkness every single day.
This is NOT another shallow motivational Christian post.
This is a practical field guide for believers who are DONE watching from the sidelines.

• How to organize a real evangelism outreach even if you’re starting small
• How to build an outreach team with unity and boldness
• What to say when talking to strangers about Jesus
• How to pray for people confidently in public
• How to overcome fear of rejection and intimidation
• The biggest mistakes churches make during outreach
• How to follow up and disciple new believers effectively
• Simple outreach strategies that actually work in today’s world

⚠️ MOST PEOPLE:
• Wait for someone else to evangelize
• Stay comfortable
• Overthink obedience
• Talk about revival but never reach people

🔥 FEW PEOPLE:
• Actually go
• Pray boldly
• Reach strangers
• Carry the Gospel publicly
• Become laborers in the harvest
This book is for believers who know they were called for MORE than casual Christianity.
And this is only the beginning.

🔥 Evangelism training
🛡 Spiritual warfare resources
🙏 Prayer and discipleship guides
🎥 Exclusive teaching content
⚔️ Bold biblical truth for real transformation
This is becoming a movement of believers who refuse lukewarm Christianity.
⚡ IF YOU’RE READY TO STOP WATCHING AND START REACHING PEOPLE—
